description:
PaintsChainer is an AI-powered automatic coloring tool for sketches and line art. It generates beautiful, anime-style artwork from black-and-white drawings, offering several AI models and manual adjustment options for colors, shading, and styles.

Automatic Coloring: AI fills sketches with colors and shading. Style Selection: Choose from different coloring models. Manual Touch-Up: Customize colors and effects after generation. Line Art Detection: Works with various drawing styles.
